skill.summary: Read, search, send, trash, move, and label Gmail via IMAP. Requires GMAIL_IMAP_USER (Gmail address) and GMAIL_IMAP_PASSWORD (Google App Password) environment...

latestVersion.changelog: Fix: search results table now displays correctly (was using fetch instead of uid FETCH for UID-based search results). Fix: folder names with spaces/brackets (e.g. [Gmail]/All Mail) now properly quoted for IMAP.
